recipe.name: Smoky White Bean Bake with Turkey Bacon and Egg
instructions: Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add turkey bacon and cook until lightly crisped.
Stir in tomato passata, smoked paprika, and cannellini beans; simmer 5 minutes.
Make a well in the bean mixture and crack the egg into it.
Cover and cook on low heat until the egg white sets, about 5 minutes, or transfer to a 190°C oven for 6-8 minutes.
Crumble feta over the top and garnish with parsley before serving.

recipe.name: Chicken and Hummus Power Wrap
instructions: Whisk together greek yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, and dill to make a quick sauce.
Warm the tortilla slightly to make it pliable.
Spread hummus evenly over the tortilla.
Layer spinach, sliced chicken, cucumber, red pepper, and feta down the center.
Drizzle the yogurt-dill sauce over the filling.
Roll tightly into a wrap, folding in the sides, and slice in half to serve.

recipe.name: Korean Beef and Rice Tray-Bake (Bulgogi-Style)
instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package instructions and set aside.
In a bowl, combine soy sauce, garlic, ginger, grated pear, sesame oil, and gochujang to make the bulgogi marinade.
Toss the sliced beef in the marinade and let sit for 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 220°C and line a sheet pan with foil.
Spread zucchini, carrot, and shiitake mushrooms on the tray, then top with the marinated beef.
Roast for 12-15 minutes, tossing halfway, until beef is cooked and vegetables are tender.
Serve the tray-bake over the cooked rice, garnished with scallion and sesame seeds.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Egg White and Herb Scramble
instructions: Whisk egg white and whole egg together with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and stir gently with a spatula until softly set.
Fold in chopped chives just before removing from heat.
Serve immediately while soft and creamy.

recipe.name: Grilled Za'atar Chicken Thighs with Charred Vegetables and Tahini Sauce
instructions: Pat chicken thighs dry, rub with 4g olive oil, za'atar, half the lemon juice, and salt; let marinate 15 minutes.
Slice zucchini lengthwise and cut bell pepper into wide strips; toss with remaining olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to high heat and sear chicken thighs 5-6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Grill zucchini and bell pepper alongside for 3-4 minutes per side until softened and lightly charred.
Whisk tahini with remaining lemon juice, crushed garlic, and a splash of water to make a smooth sauce.
Slice chicken, plate with grilled vegetables, and drizzle tahini sauce over the top.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Vanilla Almond Protein Shake with Blueberries
instructions: Add milk, protein powder, almond butter, and blueberries to a blender.
Blend on high until smooth.
Add ice cubes and blend again until thick and frosty.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.

recipe.name: Italian Sausage, Cannellini and Broccoli Rabe Stir Fry
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil and blanch broccoli rabe for 1 minute, then drain well.
Heat olive oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Crumble in sausage and stir-fry, breaking apart, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and chili flakes, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add blanched broccoli rabe and cherry tomatoes, stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes.
Add cannellini beans and toss everything together for another 2 minutes until heated through.
Remove from heat, plate, and top with grated parmigiano reggiano before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt Power Bowl with Walnuts, Chia and Blueberries
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and whisk in the whey protein powder until smooth.
Top with chopped walnuts, chia seeds and fresh blueberries.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Mediterranean Roast Chicken Thigh with Lemon, Oregano and Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Pat the turkey breast dry and rub with half the olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Place on a roasting tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss zucchini, bell pepper, red onion and cherry tomatoes with the remaining olive oil, a pinch of salt and pepper.
Scatter the vegetables around the turkey and continue roasting for another 25-30 minutes, until turkey reaches 74°C internal temperature and vegetables are caramelized.
Rest meat for 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the roasted vegetables and pan juices drizzled over.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoked Mackerel with Avocado, Rye Crisp and Pickled Cucumber
instructions: Thinly slice cucumber and toss with white wine vinegar, a pinch of salt and chopped dill; let pickle for 10 minutes.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread mashed avocado onto rye crispbread.
Flake smoked mackerel over the top.
Top with pickled cucumber and drizzle with olive oil before serving.

recipe.name: Vietnamese Braised Pork Belly with Coconut and Caramel (Thit Kho)
instructions: Melt cane sugar in a heavy pot over medium heat until it turns deep amber to make a caramel base.
Add minced garlic and shallots, stir briefly until fragrant.
Add pork belly chunks and sear until lightly browned on all sides, coating in the caramel.
Pour in fish sauce and coconut water, bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise on low heat for 60-75 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pork is tender and sauce has reduced and thickened.
Add peeled hard-boiled egg during the last 15 minutes to absorb the braising liquid.
Season with black pepper, rest off heat for 10 minutes before serving for flavors to deepen.
Garnish with sliced scallion and serve with steamed jasmine rice.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoky White Bean and Egg Bake with Bacon
instructions: Heat olive oil in a small oven-safe skillet over medium heat and cook diced bacon until crisp.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, smoked paprika, salt and pepper; simmer 3 minutes.
Add cooked white beans and stir to coat, simmering gently for another 3-4 minutes until thickened.
Make a well in the center and crack the egg into it. Cover and cook on low heat until the egg white sets but yolk stays soft, about 5 minutes (or bake at 200°C for 6-8 minutes).
Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve hot straight from the skillet.

recipe.name: BBQ-Spiced Beef Brisket Curry with Charred Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Season brisket cubes generously with salt, smoked paprika, cumin and chipotle powder.
Heat avocado oil in a heavy pot over high heat and sear brisket on all sides until deeply browned, about 6-8 minutes.
Remove meat, add onion and garlic to the same pot, cooking until softened and fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute, then add diced tomatoes and beef stock, scraping up browned bits.
Return brisket to the pot, cover, and simmer low for 1.5-2 hours until fork-tender, stirring occasionally and adding splashes of water if needed.
Meanwhile, char the cauliflower rice in a dry hot pan for 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and smoky.
Uncover curry pot, let sauce reduce slightly to a thick coating consistency, then stir in lime juice.
Serve brisket curry over charred cauliflower rice, topped with fresh coriander.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Spinach, Mushroom and Feta Omelette
instructions: Melt half the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and sauté mushrooms until browned, about 4 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted; remove vegetables and set aside.
Whisk eggs with black pepper. Add remaining butter to the pan and pour in eggs, swirling to coat the pan.
As eggs begin to set, scatter mushrooms, spinach and crumbled feta over half the omelette.
Fold omelette over filling, cook 1 more minute, then slide onto a plate.
Toast the sourdough bread and serve alongside, garnished with chives.

recipe.name: Cajun One-Pan Shrimp and Andouille-Style Sausage Bake

ingredients.name: Smoked pork sausage (andouille style, no additives)
Cajun spice blend (paprika, cayenne, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, oregano — no additives)

instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C. Toss sliced sausage, bell peppers, onion, and celery with half the olive oil and half the Cajun spice on a sheet pan.
Roast for 12 minutes until vegetables begin to char at the edges.
Push vegetables aside, add cauliflower rice, garlic and diced tomatoes to the pan, tossing with remaining olive oil and Cajun spice.
Nestle shrimp among the vegetables and season with salt.
Return pan to oven and roast 8–10 minutes more, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through.
Toss everything together on the pan, sprinkle with fresh parsley, and serve immediately.
